description: This file defines the ProjectService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, responsible for managing project and project activity validations and data retrieval logic in the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ProjectService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling project-related operations, such as validating project activities and managing project activity data.

methods.name: getProjectDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of ProjectDao.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of ProjectActivityDao.

methods.name: validateProjectActivityName
methods.description: Validates that project activities from one project do not duplicate existing activities in another project and that all referenced activities exist.

methods.name: getProjectActivityAsMap
methods.description: Converts an array of ProjectActivity objects into an associative map keyed by activity name.
